parameters.text: Search Gmail for 'is:unread in:inbox newer_than:30d' and return the 10 most recent results. Return a JSON array only, no other text.

options.systemMessage: You are a Gmail fetcher. Use the Gmail search tool with the query provided by the user. Fetch up to 10 results, sorted newest first. For each email return these exact fields: id (Gmail message ID string), from_name (sender display name), from_email (sender email address), subject, date (ISO string), snippet (first 300 chars of body text). Return ONLY a valid JSON array — no markdown, no explanation. IMPORTANT: if the tool returned emails, your array MUST contain them. You must NEVER return [] if the tool returned results. If no unread emails exist, return [].
